scope: Development-only comparison; no blind-test claim. Existing23test excluded from training/selection. Same91train27val for all runs; no class/scene removals based on outcomes.
selection: Reference is current active checkpoint at its original conf0.15/640 on same27validation. Candidate operating points must not regress precision or recall, require microF1 gain>=0.02. Prefer points reaching both>=0.70; then maxF1, precision, smaller resolution. Include active checkpoint with new resolution as a calibration-only comparator. Report perclass and macrorecall; no zero-recall class may newly appear relative to reference. If no candidate meets rule, retain active.
test_policy: Only freeze winner before optional one23 diagnostic regression. Do not tune after reading it. Prior test exposures and COCO pretraining limit independence.
